'**Ice Fusion** / Target opponent reveals their hand. If Brain Freeze was **fused**, put an action card with cost 1 or less from their hand on top of their deck.' Yellow printing: threshold cost <= 1 (blue puts cost 0, red <= 2). Shape copied verbatim from .drafts/brain_freeze_blue.json and .drafts/brain_freeze_red.json, which document this composition against the handlers; only the slug, the fusion flag and the threshold differ.

FUSION ITSELF IS NOT AUTHORED: '<X> Fusion' fires engine-side from the card DB keywords field as an optional additional cost at PLAY time (ability_keywords.fusion, ability_keywords.py:582-607 - a REVEAL from hand). 'Was fused' gates on the marker fusion() writes: 'fused_<card.slug>' appended to the controller's current_turn_effects (ability_keywords.py:604-606), tested by FLAG_SET (condition_types.py:1032-1037 reads the flag against the source controller's current_turn_effects). Flag name is per-printing because fusion() keys it on card.slug. Timing holds: fusion resolves as a cost before the PLAY ability resolves, so by resolution the flag is set or permanently absent.

REVEAL: LOOK_AT zone HAND player OPPONENT amount ALL into their_hand (handler effect_types.py:3356-3415 reads zone/player/amount/into; HAND is a supported zone; ALL stores the whole hand as a list). KNOWN FIDELITY GAP: printed text says 'reveals', and LOOK_AT stores refs without setting the cards public - the information reaches the effect but the cards are not marked is_public. Accepted by the sibling drafts per the triage note ('Reveal hand = LOOK_AT(HAND, OPPONENT, ALL, into ref)'); no DSL effect both reveals a whole hand and stores it.

SELECTION DEVIATES FROM THE TRIAGE LIST, deliberately (same deviation as the blue/red siblings): it named SELECT_FROM_REF, but that handler (effect_types.py:3540-3591) takes NO filter - its pool is the raw ref contents, so it would let me put ANY card from their hand on top, not just an Action with cost <= 1. Instead MOVE_MATCHING (effect_types.py:3593-3612) whose object-target spec filters the ref pool per candidate: filter conditions are compiled and evaluated with the CANDIDATE as the card argument (_compile_object_target, effect_types.py:705-733, 776-778), so CARD_IS_TYPE Action + CARD_COST_LTE 1 restrict the pool to exactly the printed set. Release note 'the fuse effect is not optional; you must select a card if possible': the target spec with amount 1 PROMPTS the controller to choose among matching cards (effect_types.py:792-799) and moves nothing only when no card matches - mandatory, not MAY. Release note 'the opponent can not respond between revealing their hand and selecting': both halves are effects of ONE PLAY resolution; no priority passes inside an ability.

Adopter note: batch labels this printing's set 'Uprising' - pick the json/<set>/ folder from the card's setIdentifiers per IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE step 4.
